summary.text: Steve Stern is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 10 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Aging, Banks, Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry, Energy, and Veterans' Affairs, which he chairs.
